reviews.text: Thank you so much for the positive rating!

I'm giving Dr. Costabile 5 stars only because it's impossible to give more... she deserves at least double!
She's a highly trained professional, always up-to-date, intelligible, available, and honest with her owners.
She's sweet, empathetic, gentle, and respectful in her approach to her "furry patients."

Below, I describe my experience with Dr. Costabile.

In the fall of 2022, I adopted a stray kitten who had no health problems until she was 10 months old, until she began to have difficulty accessing the litter box, appearing confused. She would only fit halfway into the box or would approach it and then move away.

A few days later, I noticed slight urine leakage. I immediately consulted the vet, who diagnosed her with mild cystitis.
The urine leakage increased as the days went by, and I noticed a slight intermittent limp on the right rear side of her body, which resolved spontaneously.
I went to another vet, who advised me to continue the cystitis treatment while adjusting her diet.

After a few days, the cat, in addition to becoming completely incontinent, began limping again, losing control of her hindquarters at irregular intervals.
I went to two other vets, who requested radiological tests, which I performed.
Meanwhile, the cat was getting worse. She approached the litter box, leaking urine and feces along the way. Her gait became increasingly unsteady, punctuated by falls on her rear end, difficulty getting up, and disinterest in food.
I was desperate!

It was clear that the cat had a serious problem, and despite consulting several vets, I had received no adequate answers or treatment.

I began my research online.
I looked for a veterinarian specializing in neurology and found Dr. Costabile. I delved deeper and learned about her honors degree, her specialization in clinical neurology and epilepsy treatment in dogs and cats, and her twenty years of experience despite her young age.
I read the positive reviews and realized she could make the correct diagnosis and, if possible, save the cat's life... and so it was!

I contacted her by phone and explained the situation.
She was so honest that, upon learning I was contacting her from Trento, she advised me to simplify things by looking for a specialist in my area.
I was adamant, and she was very understanding and helpful.
I brought her the kitten, who was now only eating liquid food, unable to move independently, was completely incontinent, and had lost a lot of weight.
She examined her meticulously, took a blood sample, and the next day she received a diagnosis that others had been unable to make!

She was very direct yet gentle, realistic about the possibilities but didn't dash my hopes.

She also referred me to another excellent professional for a combination therapy with ozone autotransfusions to reduce the inflammation.

Thanks to her, the kitten is alive, walking independently, and has more than recovered, weighing 7 kg.
She has control of her anal sphincter but not her bladder, so she needs diapers.
She's undergoing lifelong therapy, but it's manageable.

It's clear that if I had contacted Dr. Costabile sooner, my kitten would have made a full recovery.

This is certainly the longest review you'll read, but please know that to keep it short, I've omitted many important details that would have further highlighted the positive qualities of Dr. Costabile, whom I take this opportunity to thank again and again!

Attentive, knowledgeable, sweet, animal-loving, and thoughtful in every assessment.
I've never seen such a scrupulous, precise, and humane veterinarian with our four-legged friends.
Dr. Costabile is unique in Naples.
I recommend her to everyone.

A center of excellence and high professionalism.
Thanks to Dr. Costabile's expertise and precision, I was able to get a difficult diagnosis for my cat.
Something I hadn't been able to get at other centers.
Highly recommended.

When my cat, We We, started having seizures, my life changed completely. I lived in constant fear that it might happen again, unsure how to handle the situation.

After nearly three months of tests and consultations without a real solution, we met Dr. Anna Luce Costabile.

From the first visit, she stood out for her expertise, precision, and great humanity. She carefully studied all the medical records, explaining clearly and reassuringly what was happening and what path to take. She never downplayed the severity of the condition, but made me understand that epilepsy, while a serious condition, can be managed with appropriate therapy and careful monitoring.

We began treatment on June 1, 2019.
We We hasn't had another seizure since.

Beyond her professional expertise, what makes her special is her willingness and ability to emotionally support those facing such difficult times.

I'm writing this review for anyone experiencing the same fear I did: there is a solution, and trusting Dr. Anna Luce Costabile can truly make a difference.

Thank you so much for giving us back our peace of mind.
Admirable seriousness and high professionalism

Dr. Costabile is the epitome of excellence! Professional, knowledgeable, empathetic, and incredibly sweet with her patients. She's very attentive to any issues and thoroughly researches the problem. My dog ​​had tummy troubles due to colitis, and she was truly helpful in resolving it. She also worked with Dr. Vitale, a nutritionist, whom I hold in equal esteem. They made sure my little girl is doing well.
Furthermore, the doctor also performed sterilization on my little girl, conducting all the necessary pre-surgery tests, and everything went flawlessly. In short, I wouldn't change her. I'd add that I chose her based on her reviews, so it's only right that they help others choose the right vet for their puppies.

Have you ever seen a dog so happy to go to the vet? Well, I have!!! Jolie, a 5-year-old cocker spaniel, even pushes herself to get in to see "HER" doctor!!!! That said, anything else might seem superfluous because when a dog "entrusts" itself to the vet—that is, trusts him unconditionally as if he were his owner—it means he senses their love, respect, and kindness, and feels safe.
Extremely knowledgeable, scrupulous, thorough, professional, helpful, and attentive in every way: to the sensitivities of the "furry ones," those of the owners, hygiene, and order, she is capable of creating such empathy with our beloved "four-legged friends" that allows us to face any type of visit, even the most difficult, in an atmosphere of mutual serenity. The facility also offers laboratory and instrumental tests without having to refer elsewhere. The grooming service is also excellent, entrusted to staff with a humane and ethical approach in line with hers, highly technical and specialized, capable of meeting the stylistic peculiarities of every dog ​​and cat breed as well as the needs of every owner!!
Therefore, I can only recommend Dr. Annaluce Costabile's Mater Dei Vet and thank her for the excellent care she has always given my Jolie, through every step, evolution, and growth. While it's true, as it is, that there are many clinics and veterinarians, the METHODS and PREPARATION with which she carries out her work place her on an absolutely superior level.
Thank you so much 🌹🐕🌹

I took my French bulldog puppy to this vet for vaccinations and checkups, and I couldn't be more satisfied. She was truly sweet, patient, and attentive, making him feel at ease and safe.
You can tell she loves her job and animals: in addition to being extremely knowledgeable, she explains everything clearly and professionally, putting us, the owners, at ease.
I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a professional and reliable vet.

I have known the doctor since my puppy arrived 5 years ago, who helped me follow the entire growth phase of my puppy (arrived home just 26 days after birth) and she followed me step by step in raising him, until today that he has become a giant puppy.. and in addition to the skill and professionalism of Dr. Annaluce I add that she is much more than just a doctor for me... she is ready for everything and above all she is very friendly and sweet with all her clients / patients, especially with my big dog who is very anxious and makes scenes like an actor😅 she is ready to calm him and make him feel at ease, safe, my puppy has always adored her despite the thousand anxious scenes we come to her with great pleasure ready to play and be cuddled by the doctor... ❤️
The doctor is an excellent professional. Meticulous and very human. Thank you so much ❤️
Dr. Annaluce, with her great knowledge of her field, has given our Carolina her life back! We will be grateful to her forever.
Excellent veterinary practice with a very friendly and knowledgeable doctor

A TRUE PROFESSIONAL, HUMANE, AND COMPETENT!
My five-year-old cat Figaro suddenly began suffering from seizures. The previous veterinarian who treated him hadn't given me much hope, and I was feeling discouraged. I began looking for someone truly competent and knowledgeable, and that's how I found Dr. Annaluce Costabile. From the first phone call, she proved to be attentive, meticulous, and extremely kind, capable of instilling reassurance in a very difficult time.
Dr. Costabile has been treating Figaro for months, and today I wouldn't trade her for anyone else in the world. Thanks to a thorough diagnostic process and a customized treatment plan, my cat is back to his usual self and is finally living a peaceful life.
Her professionalism is extraordinary: she pays attention to every detail, from clinical care to gentle manners. In her office, always spotless and welcoming, she speaks softly so as not to frighten the animals, plays classical music in the background, and creates an environment where they feel understood and reassured. She's always available, patiently answers any questions, and never makes you feel inadequate, even when you're afraid to ask trivial questions.
An exceptional veterinarian, who has been a real turning point for me and Figaro!!!
Thank you so much!
Great professionalism and love for animals.

Dr. Annaluce Costabile is extremely knowledgeable and sweet with dogs. We had a great experience. My dog ​​had a neurological problem. The doctor identified what it could be and, with targeted tests, confirmed the condition.

Super professional.
Doctor with maximum skills and super helpful
Thank you very much for the positive rating.

I'm treating my epileptic cat with the doctor.
Thanks to her treatments, my cat hasn't had a seizure for a year.
I highly recommend this practice for epilepsy treatment.
A dedicated professional. Very meticulous and attentive.
